controlFrameEncoding.frame: A control frame is: a 4-byte big-endian unsigned length N, followed by exactly N bytes of frame body. N counts the body only, not the prefix.
controlFrameEncoding.preHandshakeBoundQuoted: Until helloAck is accepted, N greater than 65536 or N equal to 0 is refusal family RF-2, detected from the prefix alone; the receiver must refuse without buffering the body. Rationale: bound memory before any trust or negotiation exists.
controlFrameEncoding.postHandshakeBoundQuoted: After helloAck, the operative bound is the negotiated maxControlFrameBytes (handshake field): the component may accept less than the host offer but never less than 65536; the ceiling either side may offer or accept is 16777216. A frame exceeding the negotiated bound is RF-2.
controlFrameEncoding.cc5IntentQuoted: Length prefix 0; prefix exactly at, one over, and far over the operative bound (pre- and post-handshake bounds separately); truncated bodies; invalid UTF-8; duplicate members; unknown members; floats, negative and over-uint53 integers. Each is RF-2 typed; the fixture's pass property includes the observable memory bound - the receiver refuses oversize from the prefix alone without buffering the body.
controlFrameEncoding.cc5ClassificationRule: CC-5 membership is the closed CC-5 intent, the named G21.cc.CC-5 input-corpus state, and occupancy EV-5 exactByteIntent. RF-2 membership does not itself authorize CC-5 membership. non-object top level is in RF-2 covers and is absent from the closed CC-5 intent.
controlFrameEncoding.note: g21-fixture-corpus.v32 quotes invalid UTF-8 using the minimum positive value of the quoted 4-byte big-endian unsigned length encoding as claimed N, with body length equal to N and body octet 0x80. 0x80 is a UTF-8 continuation octet and cannot start a well-formed UTF-8 sequence. RFC 8259 requires UTF-8, so the body is not a UTF-8 JSON text. Body length equals claimed N, so occupancy truncated-body does not apply. N=1 is in-bound against the quoted preHandshake clause. Occupancy EV-5 oversize-from-prefix does not apply. g21-fixture-corpus.v32 does not author prefix exactly at 65536. The quoted preHandshake clause refuses N greater than 65536 or N equal to 0; N=65536 is not that refusal. It does not invent 26214400. It does not author a ping body schema. It does not classify non-object top level as CC-5.
controlFrameEncoding.encodingQuoted: A frame body is one UTF-8 JSON text (RFC 8259) whose top level is a single object.

members.mutation: Closed 4-byte big-endian unsigned length N=1 and one body octet 0x80, copied onto quoted G10 occupancy v2 platforms. Present in closed CC-5 intent as invalid UTF-8. A control frame is a 4-byte big-endian unsigned length N followed by exactly N bytes of frame body. control-protocol-contract.v2 controlFrameEncoding.encoding quotes that a frame body is one UTF-8 JSON text (RFC 8259). Invalid UTF-8 is N greater than 0 with exactly N body bytes that are not well-formed UTF-8. N=1 is the minimum positive value of the quoted 4-byte big-endian unsigned length encoding. Body length 1 equals claimed N=1, so this injection is not truncated-body. The body octet 0x80 is a UTF-8 continuation octet and cannot start a well-formed UTF-8 sequence. 0x80 is quoted from UTF-8 well-formedness, not invented as a protocol bound. N=1 is not N equal to 0. N=1 is not oversize against the quoted preHandshake clause (N greater than 65536 or N equal to 0). Occupancy EV-5 oversize-from-prefix does not apply. The receiver must read the body. Platform copies live under docs/coop/artifacts/fixtures/g21.v25/<platform-with-slash-replaced-by-dash>/ with sha256 equal to the g21-fixture-corpus.v31 payload digest, recomputed from disk. fixtures/g21.v24/ stays unmoved.
